cards.card_text: At the summit, where David used to worship God, Hushai the Archite is there to meet him, robe torn and dust on his head.
cards.verse_text: When David came to the summit, where he used to worship God, Hushai the Archite was there to meet him with his robe torn and dust on his head.
cards.snippet: …came to the summit, where he used to worship God, Hushai the Archite was there to meet him with his robe torn and dust on…

cards.card_text: But when David fled, he sent his friend Hushai the Archite back to the city to thwart Ahithophel's counsel (2 Samuel 15:32-34).
cards.verse_text: And David’s friend Hushai the Archite went to Absalom and said to him, “Long live the king!
cards.snippet: And David’s friend Hushai the Archite went to Absalom and said to him, “Long live the king!

cards.card_text: Then Absalom says, "Summon Hushai the Archite as well, and let us hear what he too has to say." The man David sent back to thwart Ahithophel's counsel just got INVITED to the meeting!
cards.verse_text: Then Absalom said, “Summon Hushai the Archite as well, and let us hear what he too has to say.”
cards.snippet: Then Absalom said, “Summon Hushai the Archite as well, and let us hear what he too has to say.”

cards.card_text: And Hushai the Archite is listed as the king's friend.
cards.verse_text: Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
cards.snippet: Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend.
